essence: The teacher takes the washed staff for a particular ritual purpose.
The guru should worship Nandin there with fragrances, flowers and similar offerings.
The Ādiśaiva officiant is distinguished by white sandal anointment and rings.
The disciple, having taken the staff, should place it in order from the head downward.
After worshipping the staff with fragrances as before, one should place it again.
